# quick-model-widget
A real DSH Web plugin that adds a compact model + reasoning quick-switcher to the composer. It keeps
the last three distinct choices in browser `localStorage`.
## Behavior

- Existing choices keep their position when selected.
- New choices append on the right.
- Adding a

fourth distinct choice removes the oldest item on the left.
- Each button uses DSH's existing host-b

acked model selection path.
- The normal full model selector remains available.
